inspiration.observed_pattern: A permissions query combines BIT_AND and BIT_OR aggregates to report the bits common to every row and the bits present in any row.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Rewritten as an original team capability audit. Permission masks are grouped by team, a NULL grant verifies that bitwise aggregates ignore NULL inputs, and deterministic team ordering exposes both common and union masks without copying the source schema or rows.

fixture_notes: Team 10 combines masks 7 and 5 plus a NULL grant, so common capabilities are 5 and any capability is 7. Team 20 combines masks 12 and 10, producing common capabilities 8 and any capability 14.
determinism_notes: Team IDs and grant IDs are fixed; the report is ordered by the unique team ID. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE team_permission_grants (grant_id INT PRIMARY KEY, team_id INT NOT NULL, permission_mask INT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT team_id, BIT_AND(permission_mask) AS common_permissions, BIT_OR(permission_mask) AS any_permissions FROM team_permission_grants GROUP BY team_id ORDER BY team_id
